chunks: Ali ibn Hatim (may God have mercy on him) informed me. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id al-Hamadani narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Abdullah al-Muhammadi narrated to us. He said: Kathir ibn 'Ayash narrated to us, from Abu'l Jarud, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him).
Regarding the saying of God, Mighty and Majestic: "Surely, your guardian is God, His Messenger, and those who believe" -- the verse.

He said: A band of Jews had accepted Islam, among them Abdullah ibn Salam, Asad, Tha'laba, Ibn Yamin, and Ibn Suraya. They came to the Prophet (may God bless him and his family) and said: "O Prophet of God! Indeed, Musa (peace be upon him) appointed Yusha' ibn Nun. So who is your successor, O Messenger of God, and who is our guardian after you?"
Then this verse was revealed: "Surely, your guardian is God, His Messenger, and those who believe -- those who establish prayer and give zakat whilst they are bowing."

Then the Messenger of God said: "Stand up." So they stood up and went to the mosque, when behold, a beggar was coming out. He said: "O beggar! Did anyone give you anything?" He said: "Yes, this ring." He said: "Who gave it to you?" He said: "That man who is praying gave it to me." He said: "In what position did he give it to you?" He said: "He was bowing."

So the Prophet exclaimed takbir, and the people of the mosque exclaimed takbir. Then the Prophet said: "Ali ibn Abi Talib is your guardian after me." They said: "We are pleased with God as Lord, with Islam as religion, with Muhammad as Prophet, and with Ali ibn Abi Talib as guardian."
Then God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: "And whoever aligns with God, His Messenger, and those who believe -- then surely, the Party of God will prevail."

It is reported from Umar ibn al-Khattab that he said: By God, I gave forty rings in charity whilst bowing, so that a verse may be revealed about me like what was revealed about Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), but nothing was revealed.

key_terms.راكع: Raki' -- bowing in prayer (ruku'); the specific posture Ali was in when he gave his ring in charity
key_terms.وصي: Wasi -- successor, legatee, trustee; refers to the one appointed by a prophet to continue his mission
key_terms.ولي: Wali -- guardian, protector, authority; central term in Shia theology for legitimate spiritual and political leadership after the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What is the occasion of revelation of the Verse of Wilayah (Quran 5:55) according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) explains the occasion of revelation for Quran 5:55-56 (the Verse of Wilayah). A group of Jewish converts asked the Prophet who his successor would be, prompting God to reveal that the guardian of the believers is God, His Messenger, and 'those who believe who establish prayer and give zakat whilst bowing' -- referring to Imam Ali, who gave his ring in charity while bowing in prayer. The hadith was narrated in the shrine of Imam al-Rida on the day of Ghadir Khumm, 18th Dhul Hijjah 367 AH, underscoring its significance for the doctrine of wilayah.
word_analysis: may God have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Hatim (rh) informed me. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Sa`id al-Hamadani narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. `Abdullah al-Muhammadi narrated to us. He said: Kathir b. `Ayash narrated to us from Abi’l Jarud from Abi Ja`far (as).
Regarding the saying of Allah, “Surely, your guardian is Allah, His Messenger, and those who believe …” [5:55],

he said: A band of Jews had converted to Islam, among whom were `Abdullah b. Salam, Asad, Tha`laba, Ibn Yamin, and Ibn Suraya. They went to the Prophet (s) and said: “O Prophet of Allah! Surely, Musa (as) deputed Yusha` b. Nun, so who is your deputy O Messenger of Allah, and who is our guardian after you?”
So, this verse was revealed, “Surely, your guardian is Allah, His Messenger, and those who believe – those who establish prayer and give zakat whilst they are bowing.” [5:55]

Then, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: “Stand up.” So, they stood up and went to the Mosque, when a beggar went out. So, he said: “O beggar! Did anyone give you anything?” He said: “Yes, this ring.” He said: “Who gave to you?” He said: “The man that is praying gave it to me.” He said: “In what position did he give it to you?” He said: “While he was bowing.”

So, the Prophet (s) did takbir, and the people of the Mosque did takbir. So, the Prophet (s) said: “`Ali b. Abi Talib is your guardian after me.” They said: “We are pleased with Allah as a Lord, with Islam as a religion, with Muhammad as a prophet, and with `Ali b. Abi Talib as a guardian.”
So, Allah revealed, “Whoever aligns with Allah, His Messenger, and those who believe, then surely, the Party of Allah will prevail.” [5:56]

It is reported from `Umar b. al-Khattab that he said: By Allah, I gave forty rings in charity whilst I was bowing so that a verse may be revealed about me in the same way that one was revealed about `Ali b. Abi Talib (as), but one was not revealed.
